description: PRODUCT DESCRIPTION  The Ordinary Lactic Acid 10% + HA 2% - a high-strength lactic acid superficial peeling formulation. Lactic Acid is an alpha hydroxyl acid that exfoliates the skin. This derivative is of plant origin and varies in colour seasonally and this colour variation may be apparent in the formula from time to time. This pH of this formula is approximately 3.8.
